head: 5badb0c362515a00772b2bdeddad457b920afc2c
scope: Read-only source/receipt review of R01-R05,R08,R09,R11,R12,R14. Only this requested review JSON is written. Manual binary deletion completion is root-owned.
outcome: Reported structural findings remain supported, with the limits below. No newly demonstrated current wrong-physics case or false parity certification in this review.

evidence_validation.source_state_check: git diff --name-only 08ac61b HEAD -- solver/src solver/tests solver/tools produced no paths (using full repository-relative pathspecs); git status for these paths was empty.
qualification_limits: These are retained executions, not a new post-manual-delete full suite.
External 156-test receipt is earlier than the final 1240-test run; the current 18 external production source hashes match its recorded binding.
Local hash checks verify binding and unchanged source, not native authenticity or universal physical validity.
No new COMSOL solve, full Vigus run, independent stochastic ensemble or million-particle benchmark.

findings.finding: resolved_models retains model/revision and only selected scalar parameters; field-role bindings and many resolved coefficients remain in typed plans rather than result explanation. Epstein delta is consumed numerically but omitted here.
findings.impact: A result-only recipient cannot fully explain which resolved coefficient and role-to-field mapping governed a model without the original input.
findings.limit: Input/data hashes are present in resume identity. This is not evidence that incompatible cases can resume or that numerical results collide.
findings.next: Publish one normalized effective scalar/role projection from the existing plan owner and reuse it for check/result.

findings.finding: Talbot/lift/Saffman primitive offsets are selected through other model-category types even though required fields already have one name-to-offset table.
findings.impact: Adding or removing a drag model can require unrelated thermophoresis/lift binder edits, increasing omission risk.
findings.limit: Scientific shared-background compatibility requirements remain intentional; no present misbinding demonstrated.
findings.next: Bind declared roles directly through existing field offsets while retaining catalog-owned physical compatibility checks.

findings.finding: Continuous applicability row dispatch treats remaining codes as existing proof families. Preparation currently rejects unmatched plan/bounds and the catalog is closed.
findings.impact: A future model/code addition could acquire an inappropriate applicability proof if its contributor updates stage evaluation but overlooks proof dispatch.
findings.limit: Reject the stronger claim that unknown user selectors currently bypass validation. Current plan/code families are matched; this is a future-change safety issue.
findings.next: Enumerate supported proof codes and reject others, preserving separate point evaluation, global bounds and path proofs.

findings.finding: Epstein thermal speed/rate and applicability gate are independently expressed in array and compiled production evaluators.
findings.impact: Future coefficient, sign or domain changes need coordinated edits and may silently drift.
findings.limit: No disagreement between current equations is established. Independent analytic/Decimal test oracles should remain independent.
findings.next: Use a small category-owned scalar production kernel where equivalent; measure rounding/performance effects and preserve independent proofs/oracles.

findings.finding: Curved and exact wall response commits separately mutate resident x/v/Z, event ordinals, lifecycle, event ledger, wall counters and replay jumps.
findings.impact: A boundary-state change can be correctly implemented for one path while omitted for another.
findings.limit: Canonical-hit, lifecycle and append helpers already share work. Curved finite-radius residual handling, exact origins and OU restart have different necessary semantics; do not unify their paths wholesale.
findings.next: Consolidate only the common accepted post-response transaction, retaining method-specific continuation and identity tests.

findings.finding: source_identity hashes the manifest and includes input/context identity. Completion validates context/checkpoint and payload structure/values, but does not content-bind every final/event numeric value.
findings.impact: A finite modified final model_weight can retain the same derived-artifact source identity; consumers needing byte/content equality cannot infer it from manifest identity.
findings.limit: Not proof of spontaneous solver corruption or broken resume hashes. Checkpoint and context already have explicit hash protections.
findings.next: Clarify identity scope, then assess selective completion hashes only for payload identity required by actual reuse.

findings.finding: Electric builder appends new primitive outputs while preserving existing unrelated fields; the Vigus coefficient producer separately regenerates an owned coefficient group and rejects name collisions.
findings.impact: A workflow may retain old E-derived charge/ion/DEP coefficients unless it explicitly reruns their owner.
findings.limit: Independent prescribed fields are valid. The preserved-zero-gradient probe does not establish a nonzero correct gradient or an erroneous executed particle case.
findings.next: Bind declared derived-output groups to primitive/parameter identity at the existing producer handoff; avoid guessed dependencies or a generic DAG.

findings.finding: Saved-population evaluation retains full frames plus time-by-ID-by-five dense state arrays and requires identical ID populations. Its outputs are computational-count descriptive summaries.
findings.impact: Large saved populations may consume substantial RAM; this entry point cannot represent a general unpaired, physical-weight ensemble comparison.
findings.limit: One 10^6-by-126-by-5 float64 state array is 5.04 GB by arithmetic, not a measured scaling result. This is external V&V, not evidence of unbounded core scratch.
findings.next: Only if needed, aggregate public result batches for explicit cohorts and add a separately defined unpaired population comparison.

findings.finding: Qualified deterministic self-resolution requires reviewed method/path revisions and zero global reintegration/event/axis/failure counters. Positive work elsewhere cannot be located to a selected cohort/window.
findings.impact: Some valid local windows cannot gain qualification from current aggregate facts.
findings.limit: This intentionally returns NOT_TESTED and preserves raw differences; it is not demonstrated false certification. Descriptive/practical population usefulness remains separate.
findings.next: For an actual event/window qualification need, choose a small bound probe or independent experiment; do not infer local path resolution from global counts.

findings.finding: Installed builder requires RZ/P1, fixed perimeter potentials and vacuum permittivity. Full-material floating-V/Q historical results describe another governing problem.
findings.impact: Historical all-material field accuracy cannot certify the current reduced builder or particle prediction.
findings.limit: An explicit supported scope is not an implementation defect. This review does not independently certify manual deletion/native preservation.
findings.next: Keep the current reduced scope explicit; treat full-material capability as a separate requested scientific implementation.

scientific_claims.practical_population_agreement: Can be useful/adequate for stated observed quantities with disclosed differences, coverage and uncertainty even when qualified solver parity is NOT_TESTED.
scientific_claims.saved_evaluator_verdict: evaluate_saved_population explicitly emits qualified_solver_parity=NOT_TESTED and physical_validation=NOT_CERTIFIED, with no fitted agreement threshold.
not_inferred: Population-law equivalence from one native realization
New qualification from source identity/migration payload hashes
All-material capability from reduced-builder residual success

scores.interpretation: Subjective engineering/explanation assessment for the supported present product; not probability of correct physics or percentage validated coverage.

maintainability.rationale: Single engine, directed module boundaries and source-bound independent checks are strong. Duplicate production formulae and accepted state mutations require coordinated maintenance.

extensibility.rationale: Typed plans/catalog provide clear model ownership, but cross-category offset branches and implicit proof-family residual branches make model additions nonlocal.

scientific_explainability.rationale: Explicit equations, applicability limits, independent oracles and conservative comparison verdicts are strong. Result-only scalar/role omissions, content-identity scope and producer-derived relationships still need clearer ownership.

proposed_overall.rationale: Weights balance long-term maintenance and scientific explanation, with somewhat less weight on future extension. No penalty for intentionally unsupported full-material/3D/GPU features.

limits: No new test suite, native solve, ensemble or performance campaign.
Review of named findings and bound receipts, not exhaustive scientific certification.
Root owns post-manual-delete residual audit, native asset hash recheck and completion metadata refresh.
